issue.description:
ADR-003 records that sharded checkpoint mode is dead code: `cmd_sync_flush_only` hardcodes `CheckpointMode::Monolithic`, while the plan's §6.1.1 content-addressed object-filename requirement is implemented only by the sharded writer. The open beads address content-addressing the monolithic root (beadrs-8daa18dc) and applying pointer-declared tombstones (beadrs-a5f95091), but nothing covers the sharded path itself. Decide and deliver one of: wire sharded mode behind configuration with tests proving object dedup and content-addressed naming, or delete the unreachable writer; record the outcome in ADR-003 so the documented publication design and the shipped code stop diverging.

issue.description:
Terminal child 4 of 4 under umbrella beadrs-5ea503fa; blocked by beadrs-337a5bca. This is the fixed-point step that previous attempts missed: children 1-3 close via bead mutations, which themselves churn tracked live state (.beads/events.jsonl, .beads/heartbeats.jsonl, checkpoint republication), so the tree is dirty again the moment child 3 finishes. This child sweeps that churn and proves the end state.

STEPS
1. Run bead sync flush-only, then stage the residual churn by explicit path (expected: .beads/events.jsonl .beads/heartbeats.jsonl .beads/checkpoint/current.json .beads/checkpoint/forensic.jsonl .beads/checkpoint/previous.json plus any new object files by full name) and commit to main with an explicit path list. This should be the LAST bead mutation before verification: close nothing else first.
2. Record verbatim in notes: git status --porcelain (must be empty), git rev-parse HEAD, and the version string of a build or git describe --dirty equivalent proving -dirty is gone.
3. Attempt git push origin main and record the outcome. If Forgejo rejects with the known blob cap (~530 MB new blobs vs 256 MB, from pre-50cd533 .beads/traces history), record that verbatim - it is a known, accepted state (main ahead of origin until history slimming), NEVER fixed with force-push. Local porcelain-clean is the acceptance bar; push is best-effort recorded evidence.
4. Record the verdict on the parent beadrs-5ea503fa notes: tree clean at HEAD sha X, timestamp, and that downstream beadrs-c0b03a33 (record build SHA) is unblocked. Use --if-revision on the parent write.

ACCEPTANCE
- git status --porcelain output captured in notes and EMPTY
- Evidence recorded that the build no longer reports -dirty at that HEAD
- Push outcome recorded verbatim (success, or the blob-cap rejection with its exact error)
- Parent bead notes carry the clean-tree verdict with HEAD sha and timestamp

COORDINATION
- If new NEEDLE dispatches re-dirty live files between your commit and your verification, record the porcelain output together with the paths that re-churned and why - the verdict should distinguish settled content from live churn that arrived after the sweep commit
issue.title: Verify porcelain-clean tree and sweep residual churn to the empty state
